text:
marco: hey all, day 1! followed the onboarding VPN steps but i can't reach any internal docs at https://docs.internal.redwood. browser spins, curl to 10.50.1.12:443 just fails with 'connection refused'. macbook air (intel) on corporate vpn profile 'redwood-split'.

it-support: welcome @marco! quick Q: did you install the company certs bundle? sometimes services reject TLS without it.

marco: yep certs installed. `openssl s_client -connect 10.50.1.12:443 -servername docs.internal.redwood` errors with 'no protocols available'.

neteng: hmm, 'no protocols available' often means the host refused TLS ciphers from your client or there's a middlebox. can you paste output of `wg show` and `ifconfig utun0`? remove private bits if any.

marco: wg show shows peer active, endpoint 34.120.10.2:51820, allowed ips 0.0.0.0/0; ifconfig utun0 shows inet 100.64.5.22 netmask 255.255.255.0 mtu 1420.

ella: @neteng FYI new hires default to 100.64.5.0/24 until HR verifies. we recently moved internal services behind a new ALB that only allows requests from corporate egress ranges 10.50.0.0/16 and our VPC peering.

ops-bot: Auto-ticket NETWORK-4688 created for onboarding egress mapping (assignee: neteng).

neteng: looks like your VPN assigned CGNAT range is getting DNAT'ed and dropped by the ALB. Marco, can you try connecting via the bastion proxy: `ssh -J jump@bastion.redwood marco@int-docs` or open the internal docs via the secure relay at https://relay.redwood/proxy?target=docs.internal.redwood

marco: proxy link 403s with 'client not authorized'. ssh -J just hangs on "authenticating to jump" then disconnects.

it-support: do you have MFA installed and registered in okta? ssh uses our Okta SSO plugin for MFA handshake.

marco: yes okta registered and i got the push. MFA shows success in the browser but ssh still fails.

neteng: can you share the exact SSH debug log? `ssh -vvv -J jump@bastion.redwood marco@int-docs` paste gist or a snippet.

marco: here's the key part: "debug1: client_input_global_request: rtype hostkeys-00@openssh.com" then "kex_exchange_identification: Connection closed by remote host"

ella: that sounds like the bastion connection is being rate-limited from your source IP. we had a spike from the 100.64/10 pool last week. @neteng can we whitelist 100.64.5.22 temporarily?

neteng: adding temporary allow for 100.64.5.22 -> 10.50.0.0/16 on firewall. give it about 60s. also updating bastion rate-limiter for onboarding pool so future sessions don't get dropped.

ops-bot: NETWORK-4688 updated: temporary allow added; monitoring 15m.

marco: ssh -J now connects! got shell on int-docs. curl to docs host over the internal link returns HTML. thanks so much.

it-support: long-term we'll move you to the corporate VPN pool IPs (10.50.x.x) once people-ops confirms start date and device enrollment. Marco, we'll leave temporary allow for 24h. please file a follow-up if you lose access.

people-ops: confirmed start date processed and device enrollment underway. we'll notify infra when enrollment completes.

marco: awesome. one more Q: for local dev, is it ok to keep split tunnel or should i switch to full-tunnel? i noticed some urls resolve locally but others need the proxy.

ella: keep split for general browsing to reduce latency, but switch to full-tunnel if you need to access any service that requires a corporate IP (or use the bastion/proxy). we'll document exceptions in the onboarding guide.

marco: great, closing this thread. thanks everyone! :party_popper:
